title: A topologically engineered hydrogel platform targeting IL11 promotes renal repair after partial nephrectomy

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《A topologically engineered hydrogel platform targeting IL11 promotes renal repair after partial nephrectomy》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Partial nephrectomy (PN) is the gold standard for treating renal tumors and trauma; however, massive nephron loss and persistent fibrosis readily lead to chronic kidney disease (CKD).

evidence.text: Partial nephrectomy (PN) is the gold standard for treating renal tumors and trauma; however, massive nephron loss and persistent fibrosis readily lead to chronic kidney disease (CKD).
